description: N-terminal mitochondrial presequence comparison between PTHR46118:SF4 and :SF3 proteins: net charge, Arg count, acidic residues and maximum amphipathic helical hydrophobic moment over the first 40 residues, plus candidate MPP R-2/R-3/R-10 cleavage motifs
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

S = json.load(open("seqs.json"))
SEQ, ACC = S["SEQ"], S["ACC"]

# Eisenberg consensus hydrophobicity scale
EIS = {'A':0.62,'R':-2.53,'N':-0.78,'D':-0.90,'C':0.29,'Q':-0.85,'E':-0.74,'G':0.48,
       'H':-0.40,'I':1.38,'L':1.06,'K':-1.50,'M':0.64,'F':1.19,'P':0.12,'S':-0.18,
       'T':-0.05,'W':0.81,'Y':0.26,'V':1.08}

def moment(seq, period=100.0):
    """Eisenberg hydrophobic moment per residue for one window."""
    ang = np.deg2rad(period)
    h = np.array([EIS.get(c, 0.0) for c in seq])
    i = np.arange(len(seq))
    mx = np.sum(h*np.cos(ang*i)); my = np.sum(h*np.sin(ang*i))
    return np.hypot(mx, my)/len(seq)

def max_moment(seq, w=18):
    if len(seq) < w: return np.nan, -1
    vals = [(moment(seq[i:i+w]), i+1) for i in range(len(seq)-w+1)]
    return max(vals)

def mpp_sites(seq):
    """Candidate MPP cleavage positions: Arg at -2 (R-2), -3 (R-3) or -10 (R-10)."""
    out = {'R-2':[], 'R-3':[], 'R-10':[]}
    for p in range(5, len(seq)+1):          # p = last residue of presequence
        if p-2 >= 1 and seq[p-2-1] == 'R': out['R-2'].append(p)
        if p-3 >= 1 and seq[p-3-1] == 'R': out['R-3'].append(p)
        if p-10 >= 1 and seq[p-10-1] == 'R': out['R-10'].append(p)
    return out

SF4 = [k for k in SEQ if k.endswith("SF4")]
SF3 = [k for k in SEQ if k.endswith("SF3")]
CAEN4 = [k for k in SF4 if k.split("_")[0] in ("Cel","Cbr","Cni","Crem","Cjap")]

N = 40
rows = []
for k in SF4 + SF3:
    s = SEQ[k][:N]
    pos = sum(c in "KR" for c in s); neg = sum(c in "DE" for c in s)
    m, mpos = max_moment(s)
    sites = mpp_sites(SEQ[k][:60])
    rows.append(dict(
        protein=k, acc=ACC[k], subfamily="SF4" if k.endswith("SF4") else "SF3",
        clade=("Caeno" if k.split("_")[0] in ("Cel","Cbr","Cni","Crem","Cjap")
               else ("Human" if k.startswith("Hsa") else "OtherNem")),
        nterm40=s, Arg=s.count('R'), Lys=s.count('K'), basic=pos, acidic=neg,
        net_charge=pos-neg, SerThr=sum(c in "ST" for c in s),
        max_mu_H=round(m,3), mu_window_start=mpos,
        first_R2=(sites['R-2'][0] if sites['R-2'] else None),
        first_R3=(sites['R-3'][0] if sites['R-3'] else None),
        first_R10=(sites['R-10'][0] if sites['R-10'] else None)))
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df.to_csv("nterm_mts.csv", index=False)

a = df[df.subfamily=="SF4"]; b = df[df.subfamily=="SF3"]
def mw(col):
    u,p = stats.mannwhitneyu(a[col], b[col], alternative='two-sided')
    rb = 2*u/(len(a)*len(b)) - 1        # rank-biserial
    return u,p,rb,a[col].mean(),b[col].mean()

print("=== N-terminal 40 residues: SF4 (n=%d) vs SF3 (n=%d) ===" % (len(a),len(b)))
res=[]
for c in ["net_charge","Arg","acidic","max_mu_H","SerThr"]:
    u,p,rb,ma,mb = mw(c)
    res.append(dict(metric=c, SF4_mean=round(ma,3), SF3_mean=round(mb,3),
                    U=u, p=round(p,4), rank_biserial=round(rb,3)))
    print(f"{c:12s} SF4 {ma:7.3f}  SF3 {mb:7.3f}   U={u:5.1f} p={p:.4f} rb={rb:+.3f}")
pd.DataFrame(res).to_csv("nterm_mts_stats.csv", index=False)

# Caenorhabditis-only matched comparison (5 species pairs, paired)
print("\n=== Matched Caenorhabditis species pairs (paired) ===")
pairs=[]
for sp in ("Cel","Cbr","Cni","Crem","Cjap"):
    k4=[k for k in SF4 if k.startswith(sp)]; k3=[k for k in SF3 if k.startswith(sp)]
    if k4 and k3:
        r4=df[df.protein==k4[0]].iloc[0]; r3=df[df.protein==k3[0]].iloc[0]
        pairs.append(dict(species=sp, q4=r4.net_charge, q3=r3.net_charge,
                          m4=r4.max_mu_H, m3=r3.max_mu_H, a4=r4.acidic, a3=r3.acidic))
P=pd.DataFrame(pairs); P.to_csv("nterm_mts_pairs.csv", index=False)
print(P.to_string(index=False))
for lab,x,y in [("net_charge","q4","q3"),("max_mu_H","m4","m3"),("acidic","a4","a3")]:
    d = P[x].values - P[y].values
    w,pw = stats.wilcoxon(P[x], P[y]) if np.any(d!=0) else (np.nan,np.nan)
    print(f"{lab:10s} mean diff SF4-SF3 = {d.mean():+.3f}  Wilcoxon p={pw}")

print("\n=== Per-protein table ===")
print(df[["protein","clade","net_charge","Arg","acidic","max_mu_H","first_R2","first_R3","first_R10"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nC. elegans N-term 40:")
for k in ["Hsa_ABHD11_SF4","Cel_abhd11.2_SF4","Cel_abhd11.1_SF3"]:
    print(f"  {k:20s} {SEQ[k][:40]}")

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14.5, 4.4))
cols = {"SF4":"#2166ac","SF3":"#b2182b"}
for i,(c,lab) in enumerate([("net_charge","Net charge, residues 1 to 40"),
                            ("max_mu_H","Max helical hydrophobic moment"),
                            ("acidic","Acidic residues (D+E), 1 to 40")]):
    for j,sf in enumerate(["SF4","SF3"]):
        v = df[df.subfamily==sf][c].values
        ax[i].scatter(np.full(len(v), j)+np.linspace(-.12,.12,len(v)), v,
                      s=55, color=cols[sf], alpha=.85, edgecolor='k', linewidth=.4)
        ax[i].hlines(np.median(v), j-.26, j+.26, color=cols[sf], lw=2.5)
    ax[i].set_xticks([0,1]); ax[i].set_xticklabels(["SF4\n(abhd-11.2 type)","SF3\n(abhd-11.1 type)"])
    ax[i].set_title(lab, fontsize=10)
    u,p,rb,_,_ = mw(c)
    ax[i].text(.5,.96,f"Mann-Whitney p = {p:.3f}", transform=ax[i].transAxes,
               ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9)
    # mark the two C. elegans proteins
    for k,mk in [("Cel_abhd11.2_SF4",0),("Cel_abhd11.1_SF3",1)]:
        ax[i].scatter([mk],[df[df.protein==k][c].values[0]], s=150, facecolor='none',
                      edgecolor='k', linewidth=1.6, zorder=5)
ax[0].set_ylabel("value")
fig.suptitle("N-terminal presequence character of PTHR46118 subfamilies (first 40 residues)\n"
             "circled points are the two C. elegans paralogs", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
